children: A Brazilian court in Sao Paulo on Thursday issued a cautionary measure temporarily blocking petrochemical firm Braskem

from transferring new funds to its Mexican unit, Braskem Idesa, as part of a $415 million financing package and a $71 million capital injection tied to the unit's Chapter 11 filing, according to a document seen by Reuters.
Under the order, disbursements are suspended until further notice, with non-compliance subject to fines and personal liability for company directors
The court ruling follows a creditors' motion alleging the funds transfer would reduce the Brazilian company's capital position

Braskem Idesa, a joint venture between Brazil's Braskem and Mexico's Grupo Idesa, filed for US Chapter 11 bankruptcy in August after reaching agreements with creditors and shareholders to restructure over $920 million in debt
Braskem, which has also filed for out-of-court reorganization in Brazil, declined to comment on the court order
